_meta.note: Ships that fly in the PU but are not currently sold for aUEC in game (pledge-store / event / loaner hulls). Prices here are ORG VALUATIONS — campaign-board fiction used only for commissioning costs and clearance bands, never a real-game claim. Anchor rule of thumb: price it against the nearest aUEC-purchasable hull of similar class and role, then round. Extend this list freely as patches change what's sold in game.
